visible_text:
某戏剧学会由12名男生及8名女生组成。若从该学会中选出5名学生为一队参加比赛且该队至少有一名女生，则可组成多少不同的队？
A. 3960
B. 14712
C. 15448
D. 15504
reasoning: Total ways to choose any 5 students from 20 is C(20,5)=15504. Subtract the ways with no girls, i.e., all 5 are male: C(12,5)=792. So the number of teams with at least one girl is 15504-792=14712, which corresponds to option B.
